component.name: Claude Code Applet
component.summary: Active Claude Code sessions and usage limits in the COSMIC panel

description.p: A COSMIC panel applet that shows how many Claude Code sessions are running, which of them is working right now, and how much of the Claude subscription's 5-hour and weekly usage limits has been consumed.
The usage figures are the official ones reported by Claude Code itself through its status line interface - nothing is estimated, no credentials are read and no network requests are made.
This is an unofficial community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Anthropic.
Sessions waiting for an answer are now called out in the panel and the popup instead of looking idle, and desktop notifications report a session that has finished or that needs you.
The status line bridge can be installed from the popup, and the applet polls less often while nothing is happening.
First release: session list, busy indicator, 5-hour and weekly usage windows.
